definitions.explanation: The act of closing a facility, institution, road, or service, either temporarily or permanently. Used for factories, schools, roads, websites, and other operations.

examples.japanese: あの{工場|こうじょう}は{閉鎖|へいさ}された。
{台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{道路|どうろ}が{閉鎖|へいさ}されている。
examples.english: The road is closed due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {経営|けいえい}{悪化|あっか}により、{来月|らいげつ}{末|まつ}で{店舗|てんぽ}を{閉鎖|へいさ}することが{決|き}まった。
examples.english: Due to worsening business conditions, it was decided to close the store at the end of next month.

notes:
Compound of {閉|へい} (to close) + {鎖|さ} (to lock/chain). Implies a formal or official closing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工場|こうじょう}を{閉鎖|へいさ}する (to close a factory)
- {道路|どうろ}を{閉鎖|へいさ}する (to close a road)
- {閉鎖|へいさ}に{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる (to be forced into closure)
- {閉鎖|へいさ}{的|てき} (closed-minded; insular)

USAGE NOTE:
The adjective form {閉鎖|へいさ}{的|てき} means "closed" in the sense of being exclusive, insular, or unwelcoming of outsiders — e.g., {閉鎖|へいさ}{的|てき}な{社会|しゃかい} (a closed society).
